links.outcome: Readability and technical term density of LLM-simplified German clinical notes versus originals
links.effect: All 10 LLMs increased text length and reduced technical term and abbreviation density, but no model achieved consistent improvements across all readability indices (Flesch, Wiener Sachtextformel, LIX, SMOG, Coleman-Liau).
links.quote: However, no model achieved consistent improvements across all readability indices, highlighting limitations of traditional metrics in the medical domain.

screen.reason: The study evaluates ten LLMs on synthetic German clinical notes to measure their ability to simplify text using standardized prompts and readability indices, alongside a systematic literature review.
